note: Lookalikes for the 'Animal' comparison. A group is defined once and shows on every member's card. A member is a card id, or 'entry:<id>' for a standalone animal with no card (see 'entries'). 'measure' is what the side-by-side view is drawn to scale by: 'length' (stats.lengthCm), 'height' (stats.heightCm, at the shoulder) or 'wingspan' (stats.wingspanCm). Groups with "draft": true are only shown in parent preview until you check them and remove it.

differences.en: A cheetah has solid black spots, and a black “tear line” runs from each eye to its mouth.
differences.zh: 獵豹身上是實心的黑點，眼睛到嘴邊各有一條黑色的「淚痕」。

differences.en: Leopards and jaguars have rosettes: rings of spots like little flowers. A jaguar’s rosettes often have a dot in the middle.
differences.zh: 花豹和美洲豹身上是一圈圈像小花的梅花斑，美洲豹的梅花斑中間常常還有一個小黑點。

differences.en: The cheetah is slim with long legs for running fast; the jaguar is the stockiest and strongest.
differences.zh: 獵豹身材細長、腳很長，適合快跑；美洲豹最壯、力氣最大。

differences.en: Jaguars live in the Americas, cheetahs in Africa (and a few in Iran), and leopards in Africa and Asia.
differences.zh: 美洲豹住在美洲，獵豹住在非洲（伊朗也有少數），花豹住在非洲和亞洲。

differences.en: African elephants have huge ears shaped a bit like Africa; Asian elephants have smaller, rounder ears.
differences.zh: 非洲象的耳朵很大，形狀有點像非洲地圖；亞洲象的耳朵比較小、比較圓。

differences.en: The tip of an African elephant’s trunk has two “fingers”; an Asian elephant’s has one.
differences.zh: 非洲象的鼻子末端有兩個「手指」，亞洲象只有一個。

differences.en: African elephants are bigger, and both males and females usually have tusks; many Asian elephants have none.
differences.zh: 非洲象體型比較大，公象和母象通常都有象牙；很多亞洲象沒有象牙。

differences.en: An Asian elephant’s back is rounded, and its head has two bumps on top.
differences.zh: 亞洲象的背是圓拱形的，頭頂上有兩個鼓起來的小包。

differences.en: The male Swinhoe’s Pheasant has a white crest and a white back; the male Mikado Pheasant has neither.
differences.zh: 藍腹鷴公鳥頭上有白色的羽冠、背上是白的；帝雉公鳥都沒有。

differences.en: The male Mikado Pheasant’s long tail is black with white stripes across it; Swinhoe’s has white feathers in the middle of its tail.
differences.zh: 帝雉公鳥的長尾巴是黑色加白色橫紋；藍腹鷴公鳥尾巴中間的羽毛是白色的。

differences.en: Both males have red skin around their eyes, but Swinhoe’s Pheasant lives lower down the mountains than the Mikado Pheasant.
differences.zh: 兩種公鳥眼睛周圍都是紅色的，但藍腹鷴住在比較低的山上，帝雉住在比較高的山上。

differences.en: The flying fox is a bat: it really flies by flapping its wings.
differences.zh: 臺灣狐蝠是蝙蝠，會拍動翅膀真的飛起來。

differences.en: The flying squirrel can’t flap. It glides from tree to tree on a furry skin “cape” between its legs.
differences.zh: 大赤鼯鼠不會拍翅膀，牠靠四肢之間毛茸茸的皮膜，從一棵樹滑翔到另一棵樹。

differences.en: The flying squirrel has a long, fluffy tail; the flying fox has no tail you can see.
differences.zh: 大赤鼯鼠有一條長長、蓬鬆的尾巴，臺灣狐蝠看不到尾巴。

differences.en: Both come out at night, and both like eating fruit and leaves.
differences.zh: 牠們都在晚上出來活動，也都喜歡吃果實和葉子。

differences.en: A pangolin is covered in overlapping scales like a pine cone; an armadillo has bands of bony armour.
differences.zh: 穿山甲身上是一片片疊在一起、像松果的鱗片；犰狳身上是一圈圈骨頭做的盔甲。

differences.en: Pangolins live in Asia and Africa; armadillos live in the Americas.
differences.zh: 穿山甲住在亞洲和非洲，犰狳住在美洲。

differences.en: A pangolin has no teeth at all; an armadillo has small, peg-like teeth.
differences.zh: 穿山甲完全沒有牙齒，犰狳有小小的、像木樁一樣的牙齒。

differences.en: A leopard cat has two white stripes running from its eyes up over its forehead, and white spots on the back of its round ears.
differences.zh: 石虎的額頭上有兩條從眼睛往上延伸的白色條紋，圓圓的耳朵背面有白色斑點。

differences.en: Its body is covered in dark spots, and its tail has rings near the tip.
differences.zh: 石虎全身有深色斑點，尾巴末端有一圈圈的環紋。

differences.en: Leopard cats are wild and shy and live in Taiwan’s low hills. They are not pets.
differences.zh: 石虎是野生動物，很怕人，住在臺灣的淺山，不是寵物。

differences.en: The muntjac is the smallest, about as tall as a big dog, and it barks when it is scared.
differences.zh: 山羌最小，差不多跟一隻大狗一樣高，受到驚嚇時會發出像狗叫的聲音。

differences.en: The sambar deer is the biggest. Males grow large branching antlers that fall off every year.
differences.zh: 水鹿最大，公鹿會長出大大的分叉鹿角，每年都會脫落。

differences.en: The serow is not a deer: its short, pointy horns never fall off, and it has a mane on its neck.
differences.zh: 長鬃山羊不是鹿！牠短短尖尖的角不會脫落，脖子上還有鬃毛。

differences.en: Gorillas are much bigger and heavier: a big male can weigh as much as two or three grown-up people.
differences.zh: 大猩猩比黑猩猩大很多，大公猩猩的體重差不多是兩、三個大人加起來那麼重。

differences.en: A grown-up male gorilla has silver hair on his back, so he is called a silverback.
differences.zh: 成年的公大猩猩背上的毛是銀色的，所以叫做「銀背」。

differences.en: Chimpanzees have big ears that stick out, and they are great at using tools, like poking sticks into termite mounds.
differences.zh: 黑猩猩的耳朵大大的、往外翹，很會用工具，例如拿樹枝去釣白蟻。

differences.en: A black rhino has a pointed, hooked upper lip for picking leaves; a white rhino has a wide, square lip for eating grass.
differences.zh: 黑犀牛的上唇尖尖的、像鉤子，用來摘樹葉；白犀牛的嘴唇又寬又平，適合吃草。

differences.en: Despite their names, both are grey!
differences.zh: 其實牠們兩個都是灰色的喔！

differences.en: The white rhino is bigger and keeps its head low to graze; the black rhino holds its head higher.
differences.zh: 白犀牛比較大，常常低著頭吃草；黑犀牛的頭抬得比較高。

differences.en: Never touch any snake, even one you think is harmless. Step back slowly and tell a grown-up.
differences.zh: 任何蛇都不要碰，就算你覺得牠沒有毒也一樣。慢慢退開，然後告訴大人。

differences.en: The mock viper is harmless to people, but it copies the pit viper’s brown pattern, which helps keep enemies away.
differences.zh: 擬龜殼花對人沒有危險，但牠模仿龜殼花的褐色花紋，讓敵人不敢靠近。

differences.en: The pit viper has a bigger, triangle-shaped head with heat-sensing pits on its face; the mock viper is smaller.
differences.zh: 龜殼花的頭比較大、呈三角形，臉上有感熱的小凹洞；擬龜殼花體型比較小。

differences.en: Even experts can mix them up, so leave telling them apart to grown-ups.
differences.zh: 連專家有時候都會認錯，所以分辨的工作就交給大人吧。

differences.en: Most butterflies have thin antennae with little knobs at the ends; a moth’s antennae are often feathery or plain.
differences.zh: 大部分的蝴蝶觸角細細的、末端有小圓球；蛾的觸角常常像羽毛，或是沒有小圓球。

differences.en: Butterflies usually fly in the daytime, and many moths fly at night.
differences.zh: 蝴蝶大多在白天飛，很多蛾在晚上飛。

differences.en: When resting, butterflies often fold their wings up over their backs; moths often keep them open or flat.
differences.zh: 停下來休息時，蝴蝶常把翅膀合起來立在背上，蛾常把翅膀攤開或平放。
